Hi! I’d appreciate a review on my PR:

leanprover-community/mathlib4#36937

This PR is in Jordan algebra, so I realize it is a niche area and may not have many obvious reviewers. The change itself is intentionally small and conservative, since it is my first contribution in this direction.

I already addressed an earlier reviewer comment (removing @[expose]), and the PR has been quiet since then, so I’d be grateful for another look.

I’m planning to contribute to Jordan algebra formalization in mathlib long-term, and this PR is meant as a minimal first step. I’d be very grateful for any review, even just on statement design, naming, file organization, or proof style. If needed, I’m also happy to explain the mathematical background.

If it is helpful, I can also ask my advisor for informal comments on the mathematics, but of course I’d appreciate guidance from the mathlib review side on the best path forward.

A couple of non-math suggestions:
Can you add a line with --- to your PR description, and put the parts that describe the contents above the line and any general notes to reviewers below the line? Also can you restore the "Open in Gitpod" button from the PR template?
I'm not familiar with the maths here, but I'll point out that docstrings with double asterisks usually refer to well-known named results. (which these might be, idk, I only found this reference)
